title: The Quiet Volunteer
paragraphs: Every weekend, Hamzah spends two hours helping at a food bank near his apartment, without telling most of his friends or posting anything about it online, simply because he prefers to keep it private.
One day, a coworker discovers this by accident and asks why he keeps such a good habit quiet. Hamzah explains that he does it for his own peace of mind, not for recognition from others.

His coworker admits she had assumed people only volunteered when they wanted others to notice, and finds Hamzah's quiet approach genuinely refreshing compared to what she usually sees on social media these days.

His coworker later joins him one weekend and finds the experience surprisingly rewarding. Hamzah's quiet consistency, without seeking praise, ends up inspiring someone in a way that public announcements rarely manage to do.
